subject: Re: Next steps — DPA pathing, SCC module choice & vendor SQ initiation
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Holm <sarah.holm@finmart.com>, it-security@finmart.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & immediate docs — DPA / SCC path + vendor SQ

Hi Sarah / FinMart team,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — great discussion on expected volume and SLOs. Per our call I wanted to summarize the immediate next steps on the privacy & security side so we keep things moving toward procurement.

High-level asks from your side (as I understood them):
- Confirm DPA and which SCC module you prefer (FinMart as controller or processor mapping).
- Get Redwood's latest SOC 2 attestation and controls mapping.
- Kick off your vendor security questionnaire (we'll prioritize answers and a short controls summary).

Our proposed split of work:
- We (Redwood) will share the SOC 2 report + short controls mapping and a DPA draft for your legal team to review. (Aditya / Priyom to lead)
- You to send the vendor SQ (if you prefer, send your doc or a link).
- We will propose SCC module selection options once we see whether FinMart intends to be controller or wants a processor-to-processor flow.

Attachments we can provide quickly: SOC2 report, controls mapping, and a DPA draft. If you can send the questionnaire, we'll aim to return answers within 3 business days of receipt.

Proposed next milestones:
1) FinMart sends vendor SQ — target Aug 10
2) Redwood returns completed SQ + SOC2 + DPA draft — target Aug 12
3) Legal alignment on SCC module — target Aug 18 (or earlier if feasible)

Let me know if the timeline looks OK or if you'd prefer compressed turnaround. Happy to set a 30-min follow-up with Sarah + your security lead if that helps.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Lead, North America
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

--
Attachment stubs referenced: Redwood_SOC2_report_2025.pdf; Redwood_controls_mapping.xlsx; Redwood_DPA-draft.docx

From: Sarah Holm <sarah.holm@finmart.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: it-security@finmart.com, procurement@finmart.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & immediate docs — DPA / SCC path + vendor SQ

Camila —

Thanks for the clear recap. We're aligned on the asks and appreciate the proposed timeline. A couple quick clarifications before we circulate internally:

1) SOC 2: please confirm the date of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and whether it covers the inference/service layer specifically.
2) DPA role mapping: FinMart intends to be the data controller for customer-identifying data; however some workloads will involve processor-to-processor subprocessors. We'll need to confirm which SCC module applies after we review the DPA draft.
3) Vendor SQ: attached is our standard vendor security questionnaire (FinMart_Vendor_SQ_v1.pdf). Could you confirm that your answers will show control ownership and any compensating controls for data residency?

We'll kick to procurement/legal after we have the SOC2 + DPA draft + completed SQ back. If Redwood can also provide a brief mapping (one page) showing where key GDPR controls live (data deletion, access controls, logging/audit), that will speed review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — target dates look reasonable.

Thanks,
Sarah Holm
VP Legal Operations
FinMart Inc.

Attachment: FinMart_Vendor_SQ_v1.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & immediate docs — DPA / SCC path + vendor SQ

Camila / Priyom —

Thanks Sarah — copying plan and owners below so we have clear SLAs inside Redwood: 

Action matrix (Redwood):
- Aditya: send SOC 2 Type II (2025) and a one-page controls mapping that explicitly calls out: data deletion, access controls, KV cache handling, logging/audit, and encryption at rest/in transit. Target: Aug 12 EOD.
- Priyom: draft DPA with Processor role by default and include SCC module options (controller-to-processor Module 2 vs processor-to-processor Module 3). Priyom will also include notes about subprocessors and our standard subprocessor list & notification cadence. Target: Aug 12 COB.
- Camila: coordinate FinMart questionnaire intake and act as single point for clarifying follow-ups; I'll support technical clarifications on the mapping doc.

Notes on SCC: we typically start with the controller-to-processor flow unless the customer clearly requires a processor-to-processor clause for downstream integrations. We'll flag recommended module and rationale in the DPA draft.

I'll drop the SOC2 + mapping in the shared folder and reply-all when ready.

-Aditya
Senior Security PM
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachment stubs to upload: Redwood_SOC2_report_2025.pdf; Redwood_controls_mapping.xlsx

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Holm <sarah.holm@finmart.com>, it-security@finmart.com, procurement@finmart.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & immediate docs — DPA / SCC path + vendor SQ

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the quick reply and the questionnaire. Our team has uploaded the materials and here are the links & next actions: 

Files shared (drive links below):
- Redwood SOC 2 Type II (covering inference runtime and platform services) — Redwood_SOC2_report_2025.pdf
- Controls mapping (one-page summary + appendix) — Redwood_controls_mapping.xlsx
- Draft DPA with SCC module options and subprocessor language — Redwood_DPA-draft.docx

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Aabc123RedwoodShared

Proposed next steps for FinMart:
- Please review the DPA draft and let us know if you prefer Module 2 (controller-to-processor) or Module 3 (processor-to-processor) for your intended data flows. If helpful, we can recommend based on your use cases.
- Complete the vendor questionnaire attached (FinMart_Vendor_SQ_v1.pdf) and return by Aug 20 so we can keep procurement on schedule.
- If your security team wants a 30-min tech walkthrough on the controls mapping, we can schedule during Aug 13–14.

If that schedule looks good I'll book a slot for the walkthrough and Priyom will follow up on DPA redline preferences.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Lead, North America
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
